messages:
sam: pushing release `redwood-api:v2026.03.21` to eu-ecr stalled during publish, deploybot shows error

sam: publish log snippet:```
INFO  publish start repo=eu/main image=redwood-api:v2026.03.21
ERROR KMS_ANNOTATION_VERIFY failed for key arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/abcd - annotation missing
INFO  publish aborted, rolling back staging marker
```

deploybot: :robot_face: automated publish step failed: annotation validation error. retrying disabled after 2 attempts. See /ops/publish/logs/3241598765

jess: hmm, is this the cross-account KMS key we rotated last week? :thinking_face:

maria: yes, rotation touched the mirror account key. It seems the annotation the publish guard expects (kms_kid) is missing on the manifest returned by the registry.

ryan: what are options? repush with corrected annotation, or pin consumers to previous digest and skip this push for the release window?

sam: we already have traffic on canary. I'd rather avoid a full revert. proposal: pin the release routes to `sha256:7f3a...` (previous published digest) and mark this image publish as deferred. Then open a follow-up to republish after infra patch.

jess: agree. Pin + soft rollback (no DB changes) sounds lowest blast radius. Need ops playbook note in release notes so CS knows it's delayed.

release-manager: schedule looks tight — we have change window 18:00-20:00 UTC. If we pin now we can continue release notes and ship non-image changes. Approving pin. :white_check_mark:

maria: infra action item: reapply kms grant to mirror account and force-manifest-annotate on republish. I'll take it and ETA ~3h.

sam: can someone run the pin? which team owns the route pins?

jess: release-configs team does one-off route pins. I can take it. will update the release notes: "Image publish deferred due to KMS annotation mismatch; services pinned to previous digest pending republish."

deploybot: :robot_face: recorded pin action request from jess. Creating ticket PUBL-3241 and tagging release 2026-03-21.

publishbot: automated note: existing canary will remain on previous digest `sha256:7f3a...` and broad rollout suppressed until republish is successful.

ryan: quick check — any migrations in this release that depend on new image? if so we must block.

sam: no DB migrations in this batch. all infra-only config and docs. safe to proceed.

release-manager: ok. action summary: jess to apply pin + update release notes, maria to fix KMS/annotation and republish, deploybot/publishbot to monitor and post status. reopen thread when republish succeeds. :eyes:

jess: pin applied to routes/stable and routes/canary. updated release notes in PR #1824 with the defer note. linking PUBL-3241. :thumbsup:

maria: starting infra fix now. I'll post progress here and ping when republish is complete.

sam: thanks all. closing this thread for the immediate release window, will reopen if anything changes.
